items.title: Christmas Party
items.description: Join the rabbit children as they enlist an older friend to help surprise their parents with the most beautiful Christmas party. There isn’t much that can convince Orson Abott to escape the quiet and secluded space of his treehouse. But when he climbs down into the holiday spirit one afternoon, a group of younger rabbits request the help of Orson as they put together a surprise Christmas party for their parents, and Orson can’t resist being the leader. “The story is warm and funny, graced by the most radiant paintings in full color, pictures that convey the excitement, tenderness, and mystery of the holiday.” – Publishers Weekly
